classification.difficultyReason: Convert the time to a number of periods (12 in each part), identify r=3 or 0.7, and count the number of ratio applications (12, not 13). Then evaluate and round to two significant figures. This is a short chain of linked steps.

content.prompt: Give each answer correct to two significant figures.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A culture of bacteria triples every 4 hours. If there were originally 150 bacteria, how many are there after 2 days?

answer.worked:
Two days contain $48\div4=12$ four-hour periods. The original number is the first term, so the number after twelve periods is the thirteenth term.
$$\begin{align*}a&=150,\qquad r=3\\a_{13}&=ar^{13-1}\\a_{13}&=150(3)^{12}\\a_{13}&=79\,716\,150\\a_{13}&\approx8.0\times10^{7}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Every 6 hours, 30% of a drug in the bloodstream is cleared. If there was originally 400 mg, how much remains after 3 days?

answer.worked:
Three days contain $72\div6=12$ six-hour periods. The original amount is the first term, so the amount after twelve periods is the thirteenth term.
$$\begin{align*}a&=400,\qquad r=0.7\\a_{13}&=ar^{13-1}\\a_{13}&=400(0.7)^{12}\\a_{13}&\approx5.5365\text{ mg}\\a_{13}&\approx5.5\text{ mg}\end{align*}$$
